title: Sleep Scoring Processing
author: Daniel DV Vartanian
materials: Abra o software ActStudio Ao abrir o ActStudio, é possível que as seguintes janelas apareçam. Clique em Não ou feche a janela caso isso aconteça. Essas configurações não são necessárias para este protocolo.

Remova possíveis falsos positivos e micro estados O software reconhece erroneamente alguns períodos como um estado de sono ou de descanso. Assim, é necessário que o excluamos para que a análise não seja impactada. Preste muita atenção, pois eles podem ser difíceis de serem percebidos. Na aba "Análise" -> Seleção de períodos -> "períodos de sono" você conseguirá identificá-los de forma mais efetiva. Em vermelho você verá os períodos secundários de sono, i.e., os micro estados e os cochilos. Identifique os micro estados e volte na aba " análise " --> " pontuação de sono " para exclui-los.
Envie os dados processados à equipe de pesquisa
Diário de Sono - acesse as respostas

steps.title: Download and Extract Actigraphy Data
steps.instruction: Download the actigraphy data to a local computer folder that is NOT synchronized with cloud services (e.g., Google Drive, OneDrive).

substeps.instruction: Right-click the file and select 'Extract All' or use 7-zip (64-bit Windows x64 for Windows 10+).
Enter the provided password when prompted to decrypt the files.

steps.title: Determine Collection Period
steps.instruction: Identify the installation date and time of the actigraph.

substeps.instruction: Open the '[volunteer id] delivery-receipt' file from the extracted folder to find the installation date and time.

steps.title: Import Data into ActStudio
steps.instruction: Import the raw actigraphy data and set the collection timeframe.

substeps.instruction: In ActStudio, go to the 'Dados' screen, click 'IMPORTAR/EXPORTAR DADOS', and then 'ABRIR'.
Locate and select the raw data file from the collection.
In the 'seleção de período' tab, enter the Start and End date and time based on the 'Readme' file and the delivery receipt, then click 'aplicar'.

steps.title: Configure Time Zone
steps.instruction: Adjust the collection time zone if necessary.

steps.title: Access Sleep Diary Data
steps.instruction: Open the sleep diary responses to use as a reference during processing.

substeps.instruction: Download and open the CSViewer program.
Click 'open file', navigate to the extracted actigraphy data folder, select the 'sleep diary' folder, and open the raw file.
Click 'load' to view responses and comments, specifically for identifying naps.

steps.title: Generate Initial Sleep Scoring
steps.instruction: Generate the automatic sleep scoring in ActStudio.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'análise' tab.
Uncheck the following boxes: 'luz vermelha', 'luz verde', 'temperatura externa', 'luz IR', 'luz UVA', and 'luz UVB'.
Click 'gerar'.

steps.title: Import Sleep Diary into ActStudio
steps.instruction: Import the sleep diary text file after generating the sleep scoring.

substeps.instruction: Go to 'dados' -> 'diário de sono' -> 'importar'.
Select the folder 'actigraphy' -> 'subject_id_1_sleep-diary.txt' -> 'abrir'.
Return to the 'análise' tab to begin processing.

steps.title: Refine Sleep Scoring States
steps.instruction: Correct the automatic inference of sleep, wake, and off-wrist states using the sleep diary for guidance.

substeps.instruction: Identify 'Offwrist' states (purple), characterized by cessation of activity and decreased temperature. Dashed lines indicate event button presses.
To modify states: Right-click the state and select 'dividir zona' (to split into two states) or 'alterar estado' (to change the entire zone). Use Ctrl + Z to undo errors.
Adjust the Sleep Onset Time (HIS) and Sleep Offset Time (HFS) based on the provided decision criteria tables, making only punctual corrections.

steps.title: Clean Up Resting States
steps.instruction: Remove 'resting' states (light green) from the boundaries of sleep episodes.

substeps.instruction: Ensure 'resting' states remain only during the middle of sleep/nap episodes.
Remove 'resting' states from the very beginning and very end of the main sleep and nap periods.
Remove any isolated 'resting' states occurring during the day.

steps.title: Final Review and Save
steps.instruction: Perform a final review of the scoring and save the processed file.

substeps.instruction: Review the entire sleep scoring to ensure no errors remain.
Save the processing to a new file via 'Dados' -> 'importar/exportar' -> 'Salvar'.
CRITICAL: Never overwrite the raw data file. Save regularly to avoid data loss.

steps.title: Secure Data Disposal
steps.instruction: Remove sensitive data from the local computer once stored in secure locations.

substeps.instruction: If prompted to save to the ActStudio database, click 'NÃO'.
Delete all local copies of the data, including raw files, and empty the system trash bin.
